instruction:
TF-PIM-001 Wave D — add the SCP federation App token-exchange step to `.github/workflows/policy-check.yml` and wire the obtained App installation token into the two cross-repo `actions/checkout` sites. This is the canonical fix for TF-PIM-001 (P0) per D-050 (ACCEPTED 2026-05-21) + the impl WP plan-doc `docs/plans/TF-PIM-001-impl-path-c-app-credential.md` §4 Wave D (R-FIXPOINT MET at v0.4 via Option A R4 mechanical override).

THIS IS A TIER 2 KERNEL-DANGEROUS FEDERATION-PRIMITIVE CHANGE. Touch only `.github/workflows/policy-check.yml`. Touch no other file.

# Required edits to `.github/workflows/policy-check.yml`

## EDIT 1 — Insert the App-token-exchange step

Insert a new step IMMEDIATELY BEFORE the existing `actions/checkout` step that checks out the SCP runtime into `.scp-runtime` (the step at line ~107 today with `if: github.action_ref != ''` and `path: .scp-runtime`). The new step's YAML body MUST be exactly (9 lines):

```yaml
      - name: Obtain SCP federation App installation token
        id: scp-app-token
        if: github.action_ref != ''
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.SCP_FEDERATION_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.SCP_FEDERATION_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: jrnb2024
          repositories: standards-control-plane-
```

The step:
- Uses the GitHub-first-party `actions/create-github-app-token` action (PRIMARY per D-050 + impl WP §4 Wave D + ADOPT-001 §12.7.13 amend). SHA-pinned to `bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1` (v3.2.0, released 2026-05-12). The trailing `# v3.2.0` comment matches the SHA-pin discipline used on every existing `uses:` in this workflow (e.g., `actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2`).
- Has `id: scp-app-token` (referenced by step outputs in EDITS 2 + 3).
- Has `if: github.action_ref != ''` (matches the existing if-guard on the `.scp-runtime` checkout step — under SCP-self dogfood, `github.action_ref` is empty and BOTH steps skip; under cross-repo invocation, both run).
- Inputs name the SCP-repo Actions secrets stored in Wave A (`SCP_FEDERATION_APP_ID` + `SCP_FEDERATION_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`); App ID is 3795720 but the dispatch reads the secret by name only.
- `owner: jrnb2024` + `repositories: standards-control-plane-` scope the installation token to the SCP repo only — matches D-050 ratified App scope (`repository_permissions: { contents: read }` on `jrnb2024/standards-control-plane` only).

## EDIT 2 — Add `token:` to the `.scp-runtime` checkout step

In the existing step that checks out into `.scp-runtime` (the step at line ~107 with `repository: ${{ github.action_repository }}` + `ref: ${{ github.action_ref }}` + `path: .scp-runtime`), add a `token:` input under `with:`:

```yaml
          token: ${{ steps.scp-app-token.outputs.token }}
```

Place the `token:` line BEFORE `path: .scp-runtime` (canonical actions/checkout input ordering: `repository`, `ref`, `token`, `path`, `fetch-depth`, `persist-credentials`). PRESERVE the existing `persist-credentials: false` line unchanged. PRESERVE the existing `if: github.action_ref != ''` on the step unchanged. PRESERVE the existing `uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2` unchanged.

**EDIT 2 uses NO fallback expression — `token: ${{ steps.scp-app-token.outputs.token }}` is the plan-doc verbatim form.** RATIONALE (closes R1 ARCH-MAJ-001): the `.scp-runtime` checkout step at EDIT 2 has its own `if: github.action_ref != ''` guard, which is co-variant with the token-exchange step's identical guard — when EDIT 2 runs, the token-exchange step ALSO ran, so `steps.scp-app-token.outputs.token` is GUARANTEED to be non-empty. There is no SCP-self code path that reaches EDIT 2 with an empty token. Adding a `|| github.token` fallback at EDIT 2 would be unreachable dead code AND would teach a misleading pattern (suggesting the App token might legitimately be absent on this step, when in fact its absence here would indicate a true configuration error that should fail loudly rather than silently fall back to the default `GITHUB_TOKEN`).

## EDIT 3 — Add `token:` to the schema-lookup checkout step

In the existing step that checks out the SCP repo into `_scp-workflow` for schema lookup (the step at line ~1149 with `id: scp-self-checkout` + `if: always()` + `repository: jrnb2024/standards-control-plane` + `ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}` + `path: _scp-workflow`), add a `token:` input under `with:`:

```yaml
          token: ${{ steps.scp-app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}
```

Place the `token:` line BEFORE `path: _scp-workflow`. PRESERVE the existing `persist-credentials: false` line unchanged. PRESERVE the existing `if: always()` unchanged. PRESERVE the existing `uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2` unchanged.

**EDIT 3 IS the only site where the `|| github.token` fallback is critical** — the asymmetry vs EDIT 2 is intentional. RATIONALE: this step has `if: always()` so it runs under both cross-repo invocation AND SCP-self dogfood. Under SCP-self, the token-exchange step is skipped (its `if: github.action_ref != ''` guard) so `steps.scp-app-token.outputs.token` evaluates to empty string. WITHOUT the fallback, the checkout would receive `token: ""` and fail to clone (actions/checkout v6 does not auto-fallback to the default `GITHUB_TOKEN` when given an explicit empty token; see `actions/checkout` source `src/input-helper.ts` which reads `token` as `required: true`). WITH `|| github.token`, the expression evaluates to the default `${{ github.token }}` (same-repo `GITHUB_TOKEN` under SCP-self, which has read access to the SCP repo). Under cross-repo invocation, the token-exchange step ran and `steps.scp-app-token.outputs.token` is non-empty (the App installation token), so the fallback is unused and the App token is what reaches the checkout.

This preserves the impl WP plan-doc §4 Wave D Action step 6 invariant: `SCP-self dogfood case (same-repo invocation; github.action_ref empty): token-exchange step skips per the if: guard; default GITHUB_TOKEN continues to suffice for the self-call fallback`. Note: this is a refinement on the plan-doc verbatim wording (`token: ${{ steps.scp-app-token.outputs.token }}` — without fallback), justified by the if-always semantics of this site. The plan-doc §4 Action step 4 should receive a post-R-fixpoint hygiene amendment to capture the fallback explicitly (operator-paced; out-of-scope for this dispatch).

# Invariants to preserve (DO NOT violate)

1. **`persist-credentials: false`** on ALL THREE `actions/checkout` sites — the pre-state count is 3 (lines ~92, ~107, ~1149); post-state count MUST also be 3. No new `actions/checkout` step added by EDIT 1.
2. **NO `secrets:` block on the reusable workflow** — `secrets: inherit` is the §12.7.10 invariant inversion that D-050 explicitly ratifies-against. There is currently no `secrets:` declaration on `.github/workflows/policy-check.yml`'s `workflow_call:` trigger; DO NOT add one. The App private key is read from `${{ secrets.SCP_FEDERATION_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}` which resolves against the WORKFLOW'S OWN context (the SCP repo's secrets), not the caller's context. Adopter wrappers continue to invoke the workflow WITHOUT `secrets: inherit`.
3. **`actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2` SHA pin** preserved on all three checkout sites. Do not upgrade.
4. **First-caller `actions/checkout` (the same-repo "Checkout caller repository" step at line ~92)** is UNCHANGED. It checks out the CALLER's repo (PIM, CT, etc.) using the caller's default `GITHUB_TOKEN` — that's correct and per-spec. Only the two SCP-repo cross-repo checkouts (EDITS 2 + 3) get the `token:` parameter.
5. **No other workflow logic touched.** No new env vars, no new jobs, no other step renames. The diff is bounded to (a) one new step (9 YAML lines, EDIT 1), (b) two new `token:` lines on existing steps (EDITS 2 + 3). Minimum added-line count = 11; expected = 11-12 with blank-line separator.
6. **No permissions block amendment required** (closes R1 ARCH-NIT-001). The workflow-level permissions (`contents: read`, `statuses: write` at lines 56-58) are sufficient for the token-exchange step. `actions/create-github-app-token` resolves `SCP_FEDERATION_APP_ID` + `SCP_FEDERATION_APP_PRIVATE_KEY` from GitHub Actions' built-in secret context; it does NOT require `id-token: write` (which is OIDC, not App-credential). The existing WP-SCP-023 023B `id-token: write` workflow-level-grant exclusion is fully preserved.
7. **YAML syntax valid** after edits — `python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/policy-check.yml'))"` must succeed.

# References (read these before acting)

- `docs/plans/TF-PIM-001-impl-path-c-app-credential.md` — impl WP plan-doc v0.4 R-FIXPOINT MET; §4 Wave D is the authoritative spec; §7.5a is the rollback strategy if Wave F dogfood fails post-merge.
- `docs/decisions/D-050-tf-pim-001-app-credential-surface-2026-05-21.md` — ACCEPTED ADR ratifying Path C App-credential surface.
- `docs/adoption/ADOPT-001-project-onboarding.md` §12.7.10 (no `secrets: inherit`); §12.7.13 (action SHA-pin tracking); §12.7.16 (App-install ceremony — adopter-facing).
- `.github/workflows/policy-check.yml` — target file; current cross-repo checkout sites at lines ~107 + ~1149 (verify exact line numbers from your working tree's HEAD before editing).

DO NOT modify any file outside `.github/workflows/policy-check.yml`. DO NOT add tests, scaffolding, env-var injection for selftest harness (that is Wave E, a separate dispatch). DO NOT touch ADOPT-001 (Wave C already shipped). DO NOT touch the D-050 ADR (Wave B already shipped). DO NOT bump the workflow's reference SHA anywhere.
verify_commands: grep -F 'Obtain SCP federation App installation token' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml
test "$(grep -cF 'Obtain SCP federation App installation token' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml)" = 1

IDLINE=$(grep -nF 'id: scp-app-token' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); test -n "$IDLINE" && awk -v s=$((IDLINE-3)) -v e=$((IDLINE+3)) 'NR>=s && NR<=e' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | grep -F "if: github.action_ref != ''" && echo "IF GUARD OK on scp-app-token step"

TOKSTEP_LINE=$(grep -nF 'Obtain SCP federation App installation token' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); RUNTIME_LINE=$(grep -nF 'path: .scp-runtime' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); test -n "$TOKSTEP_LINE" && test -n "$RUNTIME_LINE" && test "$TOKSTEP_LINE" -lt "$RUNTIME_LINE" && echo "ORDER OK: token-step at $TOKSTEP_LINE precedes .scp-runtime checkout at $RUNTIME_LINE"

REPO_RUNTIME=$(grep -nF 'repository: ${{ github.action_repository }}' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); TOKEN_RUNTIME=$(grep -nF 'token: ${{ steps.scp-app-token.outputs.token }}' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); PATH_RUNTIME=$(grep -nF 'path: .scp-runtime' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); test -n "$REPO_RUNTIME" && test -n "$TOKEN_RUNTIME" && test -n "$PATH_RUNTIME" && test "$REPO_RUNTIME" -lt "$TOKEN_RUNTIME" && test "$TOKEN_RUNTIME" -lt "$PATH_RUNTIME" && echo "EDIT 2 ordering OK: repository ($REPO_RUNTIME) < token ($TOKEN_RUNTIME) < path ($PATH_RUNTIME)"

REPO_SELF=$(grep -nF 'repository: jrnb2024/standards-control-plane' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); TOKEN_SELF=$(grep -nF 'token: ${{ steps.scp-app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); PATH_SELF=$(grep -nF 'path: _scp-workflow' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); test -n "$REPO_SELF" && test -n "$TOKEN_SELF" && test -n "$PATH_SELF" && test "$REPO_SELF" -lt "$TOKEN_SELF" && test "$TOKEN_SELF" -lt "$PATH_SELF" && echo "EDIT 3 ordering OK: repository ($REPO_SELF) < token ($TOKEN_SELF) < path ($PATH_SELF)"
CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- 2>/dev/null); test "$CHANGED" = '.github/workflows/policy-check.yml' && echo "SCOPE OK: only policy-check.yml changed (working tree vs HEAD)"
ADDED=$(git diff HEAD -- .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | grep -c '^+[^+]' || true); test "$ADDED" -ge 11 && test "$ADDED" -le 30 && echo "DIFF SIZE OK: $ADDED added lines (budget 11..30)"
